spans.claim: Betty Carew was forced to work in a shop window advertising a desk
spans.anchor: a window of one of the stores in the thoroughfare has been fitted up like a study
spans.span: A window of one of the stores in the thoroughfare has been fitted up like a study, and at a table-desk sits an extraordinarily pretty girl with hair of a most amazing red.

spans.claim: Brother John was murdered in the street after investigating the Proud Sons of Ragousa
spans.anchor: Shot dead… and in the street, too!
spans.span: Shot dead… and in the street, too! Just a _plop!

spans.claim: Dr. Joshua Laffin is head of the Twenty-Third Degree of the Proud Sons of Ragousa
spans.anchor: The Grand Master of the Twenty-Third Degree is Joshua Laffin
spans.span: The kick comes from the Twenty-Third Degree--and the Grand Master of the Twenty-Third Degree is Joshua Laffin, Doctor of Medicines!

spans.claim: Clive Lowbridge is the true Grand Prior and murderer of Brother John
spans.anchor: the new Grand Prior was Lowbridge
spans.span: No, sir, the new Grand Prior was Lowbridge.

spans.claim: The ocean liner Escorial was hijacked by a gang including Laffin and Lowbridge
spans.anchor: The _Escorial_ was by far the most luxurious vessel that ever rode the Atlantic

spans.claim: Bill Holbrook infiltrated the wireless cabin and sent a radio message
spans.anchor: I tapped off the message: '_Escorial_ in the hands of gangsters. Position roughly 64 north, 45 west'

spans.claim: Dr. Laffin was killed by Harvey Hale during the hijacking
spans.anchor: Laffin fell on to his knees, swayed for a second, and Hale struck for the third time

spans.claim: Clive Lowbridge was arrested for murder
spans.anchor: I am taking you into custody on the charge of wilfully murdering your cousin
spans.span: I am taking you into custody on the charge of wilfully murdering your cousin, Cyril Francis Lowbridge, by administering poison.

spans.claim: The ship was heading into Arctic waters and was stopped
spans.anchor: The _Escorial_ had steamed considerably over seven hundred miles northward

spans.claim: The hijackers planned to abandon the ship and escape with the loot
spans.anchor: The _Thomas Inland_ is one of the new fast
spans.span: The _Thomas Inland_ is one of the new fast.

spans.claim: The Proud Sons of Ragousa run a lottery with secret drawings
spans.anchor: Hundreds of thousands of metal-rimmed tickets, on each of which is written the official number of a member, are placed in a barrel and turned
spans.span: Hundreds of thousands of metal-rimmed tickets, on each of which is written the official number of a member, are placed in a barrel and turned.

spans.claim: Toby Marsh was secretly controlling the ship from within
spans.anchor: The man in control of this ship at the moment is an old friend of yours, one Toby Marsh

spans.claim: The fake radio message was used to disarm passengers
spans.anchor: No such order has been issued by my department. Sullivan Act applies within the frontiers of the United States
spans.span: No such order has been issued by my department. Sullivan Act applies within the frontiers of the United States.

spans.claim: The poisoned water was used to incapacitate Inspector Bullott
spans.anchor: This unfortunate animal took two sips, and that is the result
spans.span: This unfortunate animal took two sips, and that is the result.

spans.claim: The Twenty-Third Degree is filled with criminals and scum
spans.anchor: The scum of the earth, there isn’t a riverside thief that hasn’t been initiated

spans.claim: The Proud Sons of Ragousa have a secret book with society secrets
spans.anchor: It is a book that has the ritual and system of the Ragousas written down to the last dot

spans.claim: The hijackers used the stolen tanker Thomas Inland to resupply oil
spans.anchor: The _Thomas Inland_ was met by the stolen tanker at Bilboa

spans.claim: The ship was held hostage by the gang with armed guards
spans.anchor: There are machine-guns covering the deck hands’ quarters, guards on the provision store
spans.span: There are machine-guns covering the deck hands' quarters, guards on the provision store--everywhere, except where there's passengers to see them.

spans.claim: The final assault on the wireless cabin exposed the hijackers
spans.anchor: He dragged Betty into the cover of the cabin, and when Stone had followed, the reporter shut the door and pushed the bolts
spans.span: He dragged Betty into the cover of the cabin, and when Stone had followed, the reporter shut the door and pushed the bolts.

spans.claim: The warships arrived to rescue the passengers and arrest the criminals
spans.anchor: The _Sussex_ was running on a parallel course, edging closer
spans.span: The _Sussex_ was running on a parallel course, edging closer and closer to the liner.
